text: Build RTMB objective, derive bounds active parameters, optimize twice. second pass starts first optimum useful convergence check small fixed-effects model.
code: control <- list(eval.max = 10000, iter.max = 10000) obj <- RTMB::MakeADFun(   func = cmb(opal_model, inputs$data),   parameters = inputs$parameters,   map = inputs$map,   silent = TRUE ) bounds <- get_bounds(obj, inputs$parameters)  opt <- nlminb(   obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr,   lower = bounds$lower, upper = bounds$upper, control = control ) opt <- nlminb(   opt$par, obj$fn, obj$gr,   lower = bounds$lower, upper = bounds$upper, control = control ) invisible(obj$fn(opt$par))  fit <- opal_fit(   data = inputs$data,   obj = obj,   opt = opt,   bounds = list(lower = bounds$lower, upper = bounds$upper),   control = control,   estimability = tryCatch(check_estimability(obj), error = identity),   diagnostics = list(max_gradient = max(abs(obj$gr(opt$par)))),   metadata = list(stock = "Opakapaka", model = "Fixed-effects quickstart") ) fit #> <opal_fit> #>   Model:        opal_model (schema 1) #>   opal version: 0.0.4 #>   Parameters:   127 active #>   Objective:    1832.412 #>   Convergence:  0 #>   Estimability: All 127 active fixed-effect parameters are estimable. #>   MCMC:         not stored #>   Derived sets: 0 #>   Created:      2026-09-21 22:01:11 UTC

title: The open population assessment library
text: Population dynamics: Age- season-structured dynamics conditioned observed catch (weight numbers). Seasonal harvest rates solved catch vulnerable abundance, posfun() penalty keeps total harvest one. Beverton–Holt recruitment log-normal deviates SS3-style bias-adjustment ramps, fished unfished initial equilibrium, static dynamic depletion. Growth biology: von Bertalanffy growth (L1/L2/k) variability length age, represented probability--length--age matrix. Maturity, weight, fecundity can supplied age length; length-based inputs converted AD tape gradients propagate growth estimated. Selectivity: Logistic, double-normal, double-Richards, length-based forms, helpers convert SS3 opal selectivity parameterizations. Data likelihoods: Log-normal CPUE multiple indices; length weight compositions multinomial, Dirichlet, Dirichlet-multinomial likelihoods (weight compositions predicted rebinning length); user-specified priors. Estimation diagnostics: Optimization nlminb() get_bounds(); estimability checks, correlated-parameter detection, parameter tables (check_estimability(), get_cor_pairs(), get_par_table()). Observations marked RTMB’s OBS(), supports simulation obj$simulate() one-step-ahead residuals. Bayesian inference: -U-turn sampling SparseNUTS, using opal_globals(). Projections: Forward projections dynamics, recruitment deviations, selectivity (project_dynamics(), project_rec_devs(), project_selectivity()). Portable fitted models: opal_fit object stores data, fitted parameters, optimizer output, MCMC draws, diagnostics, derived results, provenance, rebuilds RTMB objective demand.
